faq_vs_guide_disagreements: CloudWatch alarm history: FAQ #165 says 14 days (cloudwatch-faq-alarm-history-14-days); the CloudWatch alarms user guide says 30 days (cloudwatch-alarm-history-30-days, added by this lens from docs/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Alarms). Guide is current truth. The M12 scan did not queue this pair (claim wording differs), so the adjudicator should link them by hand.

CloudTrail event delivery time: FAQ #29 says 'Typically ... within 5 minutes' (cloudtrail-faq-event-delivery-typically-5-minutes); the how-CloudTrail-works guide says 'within an average of about 5 minutes ... not guaranteed' (cloudtrail-delivery-average-5-minutes-not-guaranteed, added by this lens). Same number; the guide adds that it is not guaranteed. Use the guide wording in prose.
Names in FAQ quotes: CloudWatch Events (CloudTrail Insights delivery) is now Amazon EventBridge; 'CloudWatch Logs Agent' in #7 and #117 is the legacy agent name. Notes on the facts say so.
